name: CacheRegionExists
description: this function exists solely for the purpose of compatibility with other CFML Engines.

params.name: cacheName
params.description: the name of the cache connection to check (also known as Region in other CFML engines).

params.name: password
params.description:
the password for the web administrator is required to interact with Cache Connections.
You can optionally set it for your Application in Application.cfc using the variable [this.webAdminPassword].
